description: David Chen reaches out to Kevin O'Brien directly and honestly: acknowledges his employment status has changed, asks to receive the one-page brief Kevin prepared, and initiates a candid peer-level conversation about the branch situation and the path forward for both of them.

resources.detail: David discloses his status change and invites Kevin to share the brief. Trust maintenance and mutual intelligence exchange.

trust_effect.rationale: Honest, timely disclosure from a former supervisor — respects Kevin enough to tell him directly rather than let him find out through rumors.
